The role runs personalized, multi-stakeholder, multi-channel outreach into target accounts, builds and refines the segment-level playbook, and creates qualified opportunities (not just meetings) before SE handoff. Compensation is tied to [...] • Multi-thread target accounts. Identify and engage at minimum 3 stakeholders per account across decision-maker, influencer, and operational roles.  
• Build account maps documenting the buying committee, current vendor relationships, and known initiatives; use them to time and shape outreach  
• Serve as the SDR vertical partner to aligned Sales Executives, contributing to account strategy and stakeholder mapping rather than executing on a list. [...] 3-4 years of B2B outbound sales, business development, or related experience required. Demonstrated track record of consistently meeting or exceeding outbound activity and pipeline targets. Prior SDR, BDR, or inside sales experience strongly preferred.
